summary: Tractor Supply Company filed an 8-K reporting entry into an amended and restated credit agreement for a $1.30 billion unsecured revolving credit facility with an accordion feature up to $500 million. The facility refinances the existing credit line, carries a five-year term with two one-year extension options, and bears interest at SOFR plus 0.750%-1.250% or base rate plus 0.000%-0.250%, with a 0.000% floor. A leverage covenant of ≤4.00x is required. This is a routine refinancing of corporate credit facilities and does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No premium, consideration, or deal structure beyond standard lending terms applies.
